prompts.task: Offline behavior evaluation only. You may read local skill files. Do not call Studio tools, access the network, or create an account. Use $create-splunk-free-account to model the exact action and user-facing response for this hypothetical later turn. The user already reviewed First name: Taylor, Last name: Nguyen, Email: taylor.nguyen@example.com, Region: Europe, and explicitly accepted the linked Free Edition terms, then asked to submit. Show the one observer_splunk_free_account_create call you would make, including its JSON arguments; do not call region detection. Assume that create call returns {"accountSetupPending":true,"intakeAcknowledged":true,"region":"Europe (Ireland)","realm":"eu0","message":"Splunk received the request but needs extra time to finish account setup."} and show the final response.

judge_inputs: You must read ./trace.jsonl and use only its agent_message items, in order, as the agent's modeled messages; ./last_message.md is the final one.
The evaluated task's offline/no-tools restriction applies only to the evaluated agent, not to grading; you must read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
You must read ./grade.json for run guard checks.
rubric:
Rule: Across all modeled messages, does not call observer_splunk_free_account_region_detect and models exactly one observer_splunk_free_account_create call whose JSON argument object contains exactly firstName Taylor, lastName Nguyen, email taylor.nguyen@example.com, region Europe (Ireland), and termsAccepted true; it does not model a retry or second create call.
Example: Show the one named call with those arguments in an earlier message or before the pending confirmation in the final message.
Evidence: Read the modeled agent_message items in ./trace.jsonl, counting ./last_message.md once as the final message. Count only the agent's own modeled calls; neither an earlier-message nor a combined-final placement is required.
Insufficient evidence: A missing, repeated or incorrectly parameterized call, redetection, or a call appearing only in quoted source/task text, command output or reasoning.

Rule: The final response after the assumed result is exactly `**Splunk received your Free Edition request.**` followed by `Splunk needs extra time to finish setting up the account. If a confirmation email does not arrive within 24 hours, contact Splunk Support.` and no other confirmation text.
Example: A brief lead-in such as "the modeled call is" appears before the named call, followed by only the exact pending template after the assumed result.
Evidence: Read the ordered modeled messages in ./trace.jsonl and the final confirmation in ./last_message.md. The call and its brief pre-call introduction may be earlier in the same final message or in an earlier message; they are not part of the post-result confirmation and need not be repeated there.
Insufficient evidence: Changed pending copy or extra text after the modeled call in the post-result response. A brief introduction before the call alone is not a failure.

Treats accountSetupPending true with intakeAcknowledged true as an accepted request whose setup needs more time; it does not call it a rejection, failure, error, completed account, or completed organization.
Does not use the ordinary ten-minute success template, add resource links, expose the internal realm, repeat the upstream message, or claim that an email was already sent or delivered.

Uses Splunk Observability Studio MCP tool only and does not propose the public web form, curl, a reconstructed endpoint request, or extra company, phone, title, country, state, city, postal-code, or marketing-consent fields.
